title: I made my dream 2d mobile combat flight sim
author: Rain_On

comments.author: Rain_On
comments.body:
You can play and download the game (and source code) as a exe or apk here: https://benjaminbrowning.itch.io/central-front  
  
I've always wanted a way to kill time on my phone with a flight sim that works a little like playing Falcon BMS from the 2d campaign screen. Simple controls, but reasonably complex physics behind everything.  
I have worked on this on and off for years, but my progress was very slow.  
Over the last few weeks, I've embraced using AI not just to finish the project, but to rewrite all the spaghetti code I had made. If that's not your cup of tea, that's fine, I've only ever been making this for myself.  
 Things are finally at a stage where I'm enjoying playing it.  
  
Do anything you want with the source code. Pretend it's yours and sell it. I don't care.
